items.title: Cash Natural Gas Rallies as Hottest Pattern in 50 Years Grips Lower 48
items.summary: Physical natural gas prices rallied broadly Monday for Tuesday delivery as one of the hottest mid-August patterns in a half century blanketed most of the Lower 48, leaving storm-cooled New England as the session's only notable soft spot.

items.title: Short Squeeze, Weekend Weather Shift Send Natural Gas Futures Soaring
items.summary: Record natural gas short positioning ran headlong into the summer's biggest weekend jump in forecast demand Monday, igniting a double-digit rally in futures as traders raced to cover bearish bets built up over five straight weekly losses.

items.title: Global Natural Gas Prices Rebound as Iran Hardens Terms for Hormuz Reopening
items.summary: Global natural gas prices snapped back Monday after Iran attached a list of sweeping conditions to reopening the Strait of Hormuz, unwinding a week of optimism that peace agreements could be moving forward.

items.title: Bullish Weather Trends Send Natural Gas Shorts Scrambling
items.summary: As two-week weather forecasts trended meaningfully hotter over the weekend, natural gas futures snapped out of a multiweek malaise and mounted double-digit gains through midday Monday.

items.title: TTF Upside Strengthens Amid Bleak EU Natural Gas Storage Outlook
items.summary: The Europe Union’s (EU) natural gas inventories continue to lag historical levels as summer nears an end and supply disruptions caused by the Iran war persist.

items.title: Mild Central Weather, Robust Supply Tame Weekly Natural Gas Gains
items.summary: Weekly natural gas spot prices advanced only slightly as rebounding cooling demand lifted Northeast hubs. But unseasonably mild weather across portions of the nation’s midsection, along with healthy Lower 48 supply, limited national gains.
